what: G6 live latency from a cold app with the recognizer's files out of the page cache, for issue #378
machine: a Mac mini M4, 10 cores, 16 GB, macOS 26.6.1

code.main: origin/main 2105a7c5 (1.0.0) plus the recognizer-load timing log only
code.fix: the same plus the embedder loaded as the call channel's speech starts

command: AKOU_HOME=<scratch> AKOU_HEADLESS=1 AKOU_CAPTURE_FILE_ONLY=1 AKOU_LINE_TIMING=1 bun scripts/gates/g6-live-latency.ts --cli src/main/cli/cli.ts --clips <48k> --wav <timeline.wav> --words <the 12 words> --out <file>

config.capture.helper: a wrapper that runs akou-capture with --from-wav <timeline> --realtime

cold: before each run every model file (.onnx and .weights) was evicted from the page cache with mmap + msync(MS_INVALIDATE); mincore read 0% resident afterwards
conditions: runs one at a time; the machine also ran a VM, a 3 GB language-model server and, at times, another test run. loadAtStart is the 1-minute load average on 10 cores
reading: latencyMs is the committed line minus the wall time its speech ended. loads lists each recognizer load: atMs after the part started, ms it took. A cold-start line is one whose speech ends in the first 10 s

rows.text: The ACA recorder keeps the microphone on the left channel.
Parakeet transcribes both sides of the call.
We moved the dashboards from Datadog to Grafana last week.
Silero decides where each segment starts and ends.
The Terraform Plan touched three Kubernetes clusters.
Please open a Zendesk ticket for the billing question.
TitaNet gives every speaker a voice print.
The final pass runs pianoed over the whole call.
ElectroBun hosts the window and the tray item.
Opus files stay playable while they are being written.
Can you share the Grafana link with the team?
Yes, the Kubernetes upgrade is scheduled for Friday.
I think Datadog was cheaper for us in the end.
Let us check what Akau heard in the last five minutes.
The Parakeet model runs on the CPU with two threads.
Zendesk and Terraform both need a new owner.
We should keep ElectroBun pinned until the next release.
Silero and TitaNet both run in the same worker.
Send me the Opus file after the call ends.
Who owns the Pianode configuration now?
The demo went well and the customer asked for pricing.
Thanks everyone. See you all next Tuesday.
